bug_info.bug_desc: The controller PRNG-enable expression includes the persistent Disabled and Invalid flags. It therefore continues enabling PRNG updates indefinitely after entering those states instead of removing the terminal-entry contribution after two subsequent reseed completions. With a nonzero finite reseed interval and returning entropy responses, those continued updates cause recurring automatic reseeds even when no other client requests PRNG activity.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a bounded PRNG-enable counter/shift register, e.g. `prng_en_dis_inv_q[1:0]`, that is loaded when the main control FSM transitions into StCtrlDisabled or StCtrlInvalid, is shifted on each reseed-completion indication, and drives `prng_en_o` only while its low bit is set. Remove `disabled` and `invalid` from the unconditional `prng_en_o` expression, keep `random_req` and `wipe_req` as immediate enables, and default the set/load control to 0 in the main FSM so the counter is only armed on the relevant state entries.
